name: seamless-isometric-terrain
description: Generate seamless, tileable isometric terrain tiles (Hay Day / farm-game style) with ComfyUI on consumer GPUs (RTX 3060 12GB). Use this skill whenever the user wants to create ground tiles (grass, dirt, water, road, plowed field, sand, stone, snow), build a tilemap that connects without seams or gaps, fix tiles that have visible edges/mismatched shapes/mixed colors, or set up the proven "Resep D" isometric tile workflow, prompts, and post-processing (transparent PNG via rembg/SAM).
